messages:
alisa: heads-up — seeing missing req_id in logs after auth retry kicks in for the onboarding quickstart. noticed this in staging when simulating expired creds.

ben: hmm seen something like that when running the node quickstart with the auth mock. is this node-only or python too?

hiro: any repro steps? I can try locally.

alisa: repro is pretty small: start quickstart, force a 401 from the auth endpoint, then SDK does auth->retry. subsequent requests have "req_id=null" and redact flag flips off so debug dump prints. sample log: 

```
2024-10-12T11:03:22.345Z INFO outgoing_request method=POST path=/v1/generate req_id=abc123
2024-10-12T11:03:22.678Z WARN auth http status=401
2024-10-12T11:03:23.002Z INFO retry auth success
2024-10-12T11:03:23.003Z INFO outgoing_request method=POST path=/v1/generate req_id=null redact=false
```

ben: that looks like the retry path isn't reattaching the request headers that hold X-Request-ID. OTEL traceparent still there, but our request-id header is missing.

elaine: cc @ben @hiro — this smells like OTEL hook ordering. in the sampleapp we mount the SDK auth middleware after OTEL instrumentation, so on the retry path the instrumentation may not see the reissued request context.

ben: yup. the retry path creates a new low-level http call and forgets to copy over the contextual headers from the wrapper. OTEL propagator uses traceparent but our SDK-request-id is an independent header so it's getting lost.

hiro: i can put together a tiny patch for the sample app to reattach headers on retry. we should also fix the SDK to preserve headers when it performs auth refresh/retry. which repo do we target first?

alisa: sample-apps/node-quickstart for the immediate repro. but it also affects the express middleware in the SDK itself. i'll attach a minimal failing testcase.

telemetry-bot: Automated test "telemetry/reqid-preserve" failed on main at 16:22. CI run: https://ci.internal/runs/8812 (flaky test added yesterday)

elaine: note — redaction toggling unexpectedly is making this worse. when req_id is missing our log sanitizers are defaulting to redact=false in some paths, which causes extra debug info to be emitted. we should default to redact=true when no req_id present to avoid accidental leaks.

ben: agreed. short-term: set default redact=true in the OTEL hook and add a guard that treats missing req_id as sensitive. long-term: ensure retry preserves headers so req_id persists.

hiro: i'll open two PRs: 1) sample-apps quickfix to reattach headers during retry, 2) SDK change to preserve outgoing headers across auth refresh. ETA EOD.

ops-oncall: if this hits prod traces and disables redaction we could accidentally leak PII. any indicators this is in prod?

alisa: no prod alerts yet — only reproducible in staging and preprod. but CI failure on main suggests merge could propagate. i'll run a smoke with staging config that mirrors prod headers.

elaine: also double-check LB/ingress header passthrough — some nginx configs drop custom headers on 401 redirects and that can compound this issue.

ben: i'll add a CI integration that simulates an auth 401 and verifies X-Request-ID is preserved across retries. also add unit for default redact behavior.

alisa: :thumbsup: i'll post the repro gist and link both PRs here when ready. thanks all for quick triage.
